User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the Shared Space application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

side.description: Indicates which side (A or B) the user belongs to.

partnerId.description: Reference to the User entity representing the user's partner. (Relationship: User 1:1 User)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user was created.

lastSeen.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the user was online.

ProfilePage.title: ProfilePage
ProfilePage.description: Represents a profile page curated by one user for another.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProfilePage entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User entity who owns the profile page. (Relationship: User 1:N ProfilePage)

createdBy.description: Reference to the User entity who created/curates the profile page. (Relationship: User 1:N ProfilePage)

title.description: The title of the profile page.

theme.description: The theme applied to the profile page.

bio.description: A short biography or description on the profile page.

privacySettings.description: Privacy settings for the profile page.

Memory.title: Memory
Memory.description: Represents a memory item on a profile page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Memory entity.

profileId.description: Reference to the ProfilePage entity this memory belongs to. (Relationship: ProfilePage 1:N Memory)

uploaderId.description: Reference to the User entity who uploaded the memory. (Relationship: User 1:N Memory)

type.description: The type of memory (image, video, audio).

storagePath.description: The storage path for the memory file (e.g., Firebase Storage path).

thumbPath.description: The storage path for the memory thumbnail file.

dateTaken.description: The date the memory was taken.

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the memory (e.g., EXIF data).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the memory was created.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a message on a profile page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

profileId.description: Reference to the ProfilePage entity this message belongs to. (Relationship: ProfilePage 1:N Message)

authorId.description: Reference to the User entity who authored the message. (Relationship: User 1:N Message)

scheduledDate.description: The date the message is scheduled to be delivered.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was created.

SharedEntry.title: SharedEntry
SharedEntry.description: Represents an entry in the shared archive.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SharedEntry entity.

type.description: The type of shared entry (photo, note, milestone).

createdBy.description: Reference to the User entity who created the shared entry. (Relationship: User 1:N SharedEntry)

visibility.description: The visibility of the shared entry.

content.description: The content of the shared entry.

mediaIds.description: References to Media entities associated with this SharedEntry. (Relationship: Media 1:N SharedEntry)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the shared entry was created.

Media.title: Media
Media.description: Represents a media file (image, video, audio).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Media entity.

storagePath.description: The storage path for the media file (e.g., Firebase Storage path).

thumbPath.description: The storage path for the media thumbnail file.

type.description: The type of media (image, video, audio).

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the media file.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the media file was uploaded.

Presence.title: Presence
Presence.description: Represents the online presence status of a user.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity. (Relationship: User 1:1 Presence)

online.description: Indicates whether the user is currently online.

lastSeen.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the user was online.

connectionId.description: The connection ID for the user's presence.

VaultItem.title: VaultItem
VaultItem.description: Represents an encrypted item in the vault.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VaultItem entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User entity who owns the vault item. (Relationship: User 1:N VaultItem)

ciphertext.description: The encrypted content of the vault item.

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the vault item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the vault item was created.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore structure is designed to support the 'Shared Space' application, prioritizing security, scalability, and debuggability by adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC (Database-Based Access Control), and QAPs (Rules are not Filters).  

**Authorization Independence:** Achieved through denormalization. For instance, ProfilePages are stored under `/users/{userId}/profilePages/{profilePageId}`. While there's a clear hierarchical relationship, any data needed for authorization from the User document (e.g., side) would be denormalized directly into the ProfilePage document if needed.  This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules to check user attributes, allowing for atomic operations.

**Structural Segregation:** Each collection is designed to hold documents with similar security requirements. User data is stored under `/users/{userId}`, ProfilePages under `/users/{userId}/profilePages/{profilePageId}`, Memories under `/users/{userId}/profilePages/{profilePageId}/memories/{memoryId}`, VaultItems under `/users/{userId}/vaultItems/{vaultItemId}`, and so on.  SharedEntries are placed under `/sharedEntries/{sharedEntryId}` since they are collaborative, and require a different security posture.

**Access Modeling:** Uses path-based ownership for private data like User profiles and VaultItems ( `/users/{userId}/vaultItems/{vaultItemId}`).  The profile pages, memories and messages are stored in hierarchical path which allows efficient and secure ownership based security rules. SharedEntries will likely need a membership map if the intention is to limit access to specific pairs of users.  This would involve denormalizing a `members` map into each SharedEntry document:  `members: {userA: true, userB: true}`.  Presence data is stored in a dedicated collection, `/presence/{userId}`, reflecting a 1:1 relationship with users and enabling easy tracking of online status. Global roles (if needed) would be managed via dedicated collections (e.g., `/roles_admin/{uid}`).

**QAPs Support:** Segregation into dedicated collections allows for secure `list` operations.  For example, listing profile pages is done within the scope of a single user (`/users/{userId}/profilePages`) instead of querying across all profile pages.  Shared entries use a dedicated collection, and potentially a membership model to allow listing to authorized members. If global visibility is needed, a visibility field in `SharedEntry` can be used in the security rules.

**Data Clarity and Predictability:**  The schema enforces invariants such as ownership (e.g., `ownerId` in `ProfilePage`, `VaultItem`) and timestamps (`createdAt`). Consistent naming conventions are used throughout the structure. Explicit state modeling can be introduced with a status field if required for some entities. For example, a profilePage status can be 'draft', 'published' which would impact rules.

This structure promotes clear, robust security rules that are easier to understand, debug, and maintain.
